g.text: Without a gene panel, the genome converges on BUB1B

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 10.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Every gene with a high- or moderate-impact allele competed (6 321 genes). BUB1B is top-ranked in 14 of 15 sensitivity analyses of this genome, and an external tool on the same VCF places it #2 of 398.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 10.5px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: It is #4 in the frozen A0 and #1 after repairing missing frequencies: both numbers are always reported. Phase is unresolved, so this is a strong candidate, not a diagnosis.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif
